config.name: go2_shared_prefix_stop_or_continue

selection.checkpoint: single fixed round; no best checkpoint selection
selection.primary: ordered success, then successful completion time
secondary: total physical steps including calibration and warmup
wall time including model and adjoint costs

config.scene_changes: new declared paired tasks; identical world within each pair; immutable after first run

pathwise.response: factual g plus current minus old 10-step policy response under frozen f
pathwise.rollout: entire selected MPC plan; actual-return V beyond its horizon
pathwise.task_loss: shared MPC task proxy; actual PPO return is unchanged

protocol.frozen_actor_arm: frozen uses matched 5250 steps for critic and factual fitting only
protocol.common_initialization: public actor and previous seed11 factual f/g; zero added context weights; fresh critic; fresh common optimizer states
protocol.common_calibration: one complete deterministic episode per training condition; fit current response and actual-return critic; no actor update
protocol.evaluation: one complete episode per arm and case; long cases never used for fitting, learning or selection
protocol.primary: ordered complete success, then full completion time within the same task
protocol.reference: same public actor with geometric follower on all complete cases; additional practical reference
protocol.learning_signal: actual undiscounted episode return; pathwise additionally uses unchanged 0.1 whole-plan loss with explicit future stop/pass context
protocol.continuity: no physics, action history or return reset at intermediate stops; only task checkpoint index and hold timer advance
protocol.speed_permissions: same 0.69 straight / 0.55 turn command ceilings and stop braking/recovery rule for every arm

change: unfulfilled mandatory stops block route credit; same checkpoints and tasks
training_source: original fixed run; no training with the corrected planning objective
follower_reused: The corrected mission cost is never called by the geometric follower
